title: Preparation for salah
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Spring 2: The Prophet ﷺ as leader; Shahadah and Salah (1.7, 3.1, 3.2)
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y10 lesson 23 (Pupil PDF worksheet: preparation for salah)
intro: Lesson 23: 3.2 How Salah is performed: wudu, times and qiblah. To understand how Muslims prepare for salah: wudu, the prayer times and facing the qiblah

questions.q: Describe how a Muslim prepares for salah. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: Wudu as in 5:6; clean body, clothes and place; cover the body modestly; check the prayer time; face the qiblah; make the niyyah.
questions.model: Point 1: purification. Develop: wudu washing face, arms, wiping head and washing feet (5:6). Point 2: the right time and direction. Develop: each prayer has set times (4:103) and Muslims face the qiblah (2:144).

questions.q: Facing the Ka'bah is commanded in ...
Fajr has how many fard rak'ahs?
In the portal response box: 'Explain why preparation for salah is part of worship.' Two developed paragraphs with evidence. Start: 'Preparation is part of worship because ...'
questions.a: Purity is commanded (5:6) and loved by Allah (2:222); times show obedience (4:103); qiblah unites (2:144); niyyah makes it worship
questions.model: Teacher writes: 'Preparation is part of worship because Allah Himself commands wudu before prayer (5:6) ...'

questions.q: total the fard rak'ahs in a day.
what does the change of qiblah (2 AH) teach about obedience?
questions.a: The Companions turned at once in obedience; worship follows Allah's command.

questions.q: Back to our ponder: why prepare?
questions.a: Salah is meeting Allah: preparation brings purity, focus and unity.
